caption:
This came in IIM B UGAT 2025 👀

Anju drives 18 km west, turns right for 14 km, right for 9 km, then right for 2 km. How far is she from the start?

Pause, try it, and comment your answer before the solution shows 👇

The full 2025 paper is on the IPM Careers portal: study.ipmcareer.com

#IIMBUGAT #IIMBangalore #PYQ #IPMCareers #LogicalReasoning
answer: (a) 15 km: F is 9 km west and 12 km north of the start, and the square root of (81 + 144) is 15
